name: @hame/desktop
description: hame's desktop app (Tauri v2). Its own npm project, outside the root workspace, so installing the web interface's tools never fetches the Tauri CLI.

scripts.build:smoke: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/smoke tauri build --bundles app --features smoke --config src-tauri/tauri.smoke.conf.json
scripts.icons: tauri icon icons/hame.svg --output src-tauri/icons && tauri icon icons/tray.svg --output icons/.tray --png 44 && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.copyFileSync('icons/.tray/44x44.png','src-tauri/icons/tray-template.png');for(const d of ['icons/.tray','src-tauri/icons/ios','src-tauri/icons/android'])fs.rmSync(d,{recursive:true,force:true});for(const f of fs.readdirSync('src-tauri/icons'))if(/^Square|^StoreLogo/.test(f))fs.rmSync('src-tauri/icons/'+f)"
